text:
After over a year, 2,300+ hours of work, and countless iterations, my first-ever creative portfolio is finally live!

Explore the live experience: https://t.co/eQwQg3hYxm

Built with Three.js, GSAP, and Rapier, it became a much bigger project than I initially imagined. Bringing everything together took time, but I’m excited to finally let you loose in it.

Give it a spin and let me know what you think! I’d especially appreciate feedback on navigation and performance on your device.

Feedback, critique, or just a hello is always welcome!  🧵👇

#threejs #threejsJourney #tsl #portfolio #webgl
